commands.name: Admin
commands.description: Adds the specified player to the list of users with administrator privileges.

commands.name: Admins
commands.description: Outputs a list of the server's administrators to the server console.

commands.name: Airdrop
commands.description: Immediately forces a dropship to fly over the map and perform an airdrop.

commands.name: AllowP2PRelay
commands.description: Toggles usage of the ISteamNetworking member function AllowP2PPacketRelay.

commands.name: Animal
commands.description: Spawns an animal in front of the specified player, or the executing player if none is given.

commands.name: Ban
commands.description: Bans the specified player. Blank reason/duration defaults to "unspecified" for 365 days.

commands.name: Bans
commands.description: Outputs a list of the server's player bans to the server console.

commands.name: Chatrate
commands.description: Assigns a cooldown between chat messages, in seconds.

commands.name: Cheats
commands.description: Allows the usage of cheat commands.

commands.name: Cycle
commands.description: Assigns the length of the day/night cycle in seconds.

commands.name: Day
commands.description: Sets the current time to daytime.

commands.name: Debug
commands.description: Outputs information on the state of the server, to the server console.

commands.name: EffectUI
commands.description: Spawns a UI effect for the executing player.

commands.name: Experience
commands.description: Gives a player some experience points. Defaults to the executing player.

commands.name: Filter
commands.description: Filters out players with non-English, non-alphanumeric names.

commands.name: Flag
commands.description: Sets a player's flag. Defaults to the executing player.

commands.name: GameMode
commands.description: Assigns the game mode of the server.

commands.name: Give
commands.description: Gives a player an item. Defaults to the executing player and an amount of 1.

commands.name: Gold
commands.description: Marks the server as joinable only by Gold members.

commands.name: GSLT
commands.description: Sets the game server login token.

commands.name: Help
commands.description: Outputs information on commands, to the server console.

commands.name: Hide_Admins
commands.description: Hides the visibility of admin labels from players.

commands.name: Kick
commands.description: Disconnects the specified player from the server. Reason defaults to "unspecified".

commands.name: Kill
commands.description: Kills the specified player in-game.

commands.name: Map
commands.description: Sets the map that the server loads on startup.

commands.name: MaxPlayers
commands.description: Sets the maximum number of connections the server is willing to accept.

commands.name: Mode
commands.description: Assigns the difficulty of the server.

commands.name: Name
commands.description: Assigns the name of the server as shown on the server list.

commands.name: Night
commands.description: Sets the current time to night.

commands.name: Owner
commands.description: Sets the owner of the server.

commands.name: Password
commands.description: Assigns the password required for entry into the server.

commands.name: Permit
commands.description: Adds the specified player to the list of users allowed to join the server.

commands.name: Permits
commands.description: Outputs a list of the players permitted to join the server, to the server console.

commands.name: Perspective
commands.description: Assigns the perspective of the server.

commands.name: Players
commands.description: Outputs a list of the current players on the server, to the server console.

commands.name: Port
commands.description: Assigns the port of the server.

commands.name: PvE
commands.description: Disables player-versus-player combat, in favor of player-versus-environment combat.

commands.name: Quest
commands.description: Gives a player a quest flag. Defaults to the executing player.

commands.name: Queue_Size
commands.description: Sets the maximum number of queued connections the server is willing to hold on to.

commands.name: Reload
commands.description: Reloads an asset specified by its GUID, or the contents of a directory.

commands.name: Reputation
commands.description: Gives a player some reputation. Defaults to the executing player.

commands.name: ResetConfig
commands.description: Resets the config file to the default values.

commands.name: Save
commands.description: Forces a proper save of the server state.

commands.name: Say
commands.description: Broadcasts a message to all of the connected clients, via the in-game chat.

commands.name: Shutdown
commands.description: Properly saves the server state, disconnects the clients, and closes the server.

commands.name: Slay
commands.description: Kills the specified player in-game, and then permanently bans them.

commands.name: Spy
commands.description: Requests a screenshot from the target player and saves it on the caller's computer as Spy.jpg.

commands.name: Sync
commands.description: Allows players to share savedata between your servers.

commands.name: Teleport
commands.description: Teleports a player to either another player, a location node, a waypoint (via "wp"), or a bed.

commands.name: Time
commands.description: Assigns the current time of the day-night cycle, in seconds.

commands.name: Timeout
commands.description: Assigns a maximum ping threshold to the server before a client is kicked.

commands.name: Unadmin
commands.description: Removes the specified player from the list of users allowed to use admin commands in the chat.

commands.name: Unban
commands.description: Removes the specified player from the list of users not allowed to join the server.

commands.name: UnlockNpcAchievement
commands.description: Grants a player the specified achievement.

commands.name: Unpermit
commands.description: Removes the specified player from the list of users permitted to join the server.

commands.name: Vehicle
commands.description: Spawns a vehicle in front of a player. Defaults to the executing player.

commands.name: Weather
commands.description: Manipulates the current weather cycle.

commands.name: Welcome
commands.description: Sets a welcome message that is shown to clients once they connect.

commands.name: Whitelisted
commands.description: Makes the server joinable only by permitted players.
